block.name: Threshold + Repeatability
block.focus: Spring 2027 road-race durability and repeatable threshold attacks; Monday sweet spot, Tuesday over-threshold surges, Wednesday endurance, Friday training race.

history.source: Zwift FTP estimate after Tour of Watopia Stage 5

targets.additionalRide: Wednesday planned 60-minute endurance at 145–170 W. Road to Sky/Alpe badge attempts are optional substitutes for an endurance day, not additional hard volume.
targets.recoveryPolicy: Recovery and easy days should respond to fatigue rather than rigidly requiring training every day.

thresholdProgression.prescription: Progress closer to threshold as tolerated

primary.guidance: Race if HR and legs feel normal; otherwise use the upper-B RoboPacer durability ride.

fallback.guidance: Stay efficiently attached for approximately 60 minutes.

bunchFinish.priority: For now, finishing empty after going slightly early is preferable to finishing with a major match unused.

zwiftWorkout.name: Threshold Pushing
zwiftWorkout.description: A threshold workout built around two sustained 15-minute efforts.
zwiftWorkout.matchReason: Contains 2×15 minutes at 95% FTP with 10 minutes recovery, closely matching the prescribed 2×15 minutes at 90–95% FTP.
zwiftWorkout.notes: Use the prescribed 90–95% range as the authority; reduce intensity if fatigue warrants it.

weeks.label: Threshold + Repeatability · Week 3
weeks.emphasis: Progress to controlled 2×20 threshold work after a high-volume week; keep Wednesday easy and arrive fresh for Friday race craft.

workouts.title: Strength · controlled full body
workouts.detail: 30–40 min · moderate lower-body volume only; stop well short of failure so Tuesday quality is protected

workouts.title: Threshold progression · 2×20
workouts.detail: 60 min · 10 min progressive warm-up; 2×20 min at 214–221 W (91–94% FTP) with 5 min easy at 115–140 W; 5 min cool-down. Hold even power and finish capable of one more interval.

zwiftWorkout.name: XX SST 2 x 20min
zwiftWorkout.description: Two 20-minute sweet-spot blocks with brief controlled surges.
zwiftWorkout.matchReason: It supplies two 20-minute work blocks but its repeated 110% surges make it harder than this week's controlled 91–94% prescription after a high-volume week.
zwiftWorkout.notes: The steady prescription is preferred this week. Use this Zwift workout only if fully recovered, or lower workout intensity so the work blocks average within 214–221 W.

workouts.title: Easy endurance
workouts.detail: 60 min · 10 min easy warm-up; 40 min at 140–165 W conversational Z2; 5 min relaxed high-cadence spinning; 5 min cool-down. Optional upper-body/core later, but no heavy legs.

workouts.title: Rest · optional upper/core
workouts.detail: No ride. Mobility or 15–20 min upper-body/core only; protect fresh legs for Friday.

workouts.title: Zwift race simulation
workouts.detail: About 60 min total · 10 min progressive warm-up with 3×10 sec openers; choose a 45–50 min useful race when possible; 5 min cool-down. Race craft: stay economical, then launch earlier than instinct—go-zone opens near 0.5 mi. Upper-B RoboPacer for 60 min is the fallback.

weeks.label: Threshold + Repeatability · Week 4
weeks.emphasis: Consolidate the block near threshold while using Road to Sky for climbing durability; accept manageable residual fatigue for Friday race craft.

workouts.title: Sweet Spot Ramps · completed
workouts.detail: 71 min completed · 188 W normalized power · 223 W for 10 min. Controlled sweet-spot work that felt easy with reserve, so it counts as this week's first ride without adding extra volume.

workouts.title: Strength · controlled full body
workouts.detail: 30–40 min · moderate lower-body volume, stop with about 2 reps in reserve; no ride. This is the final lower-body strength work before Friday.

workouts.title: Road to Sky · near-threshold climbing
workouts.detail: About 65–75 min: 10 min progressive warm-up at 130–175 W; 3×10 min at 223–228 W (95–97% FTP), with 4 min easy at 120–145 W; continue toward the Alpe summit at 165–190 W, then 5 min easy. If the badge attempt runs longer, prioritize steady completion over forcing extra intensity.

workouts.title: Recovery · optional upper/core
workouts.detail: No ride and no heavy legs. Mobility or 15–20 min upper-body/core only.

workouts.title: Zwift race simulation · under training load
workouts.detail: About 60 min: 10 min progressive warm-up with 3×10 sec high-cadence openers; 45–55 min race; 5 min cool-down. Stay economical, make one committed move, and launch earlier than instinct—the go-zone opens near 0.5 mi. Upper-B RoboPacer for 60 min is the fallback.

weeks.label: Threshold + Repeatability · Week 5
weeks.emphasis: Consolidate the new 241 W FTP with controlled threshold work, preserve short-power snap without adding a third hard day, and arrive fresh enough to execute Friday race craft.

workouts.title: Recovery + optional upper/core
workouts.detail: No ride. Mobility or 15–20 min upper-body/core only. Skip heavy lower-body lifting so Tuesday’s threshold work reflects cycling fitness rather than gym fatigue.

workouts.title: Threshold consolidation · 3×10
workouts.detail: About 60 min: 10 min progressive warm-up at 130–180 W with 3×10 sec high-cadence spin-ups; 3×10 min at 222–229 W (92–95% of 241 W FTP) with 4 min easy at 120–145 W between; 12 min easy cool-down. Hold the first and third intervals within about 3 W. If HR is unusually high or legs remain flat from last week, use 217–222 W instead.

workouts.title: Aerobic durability + 30 sec snap
workouts.detail: About 60 min: 12 min easy warm-up; 4×30 sec at 350–400 W with 4:30 very easy at 115–145 W after each; 23 min steady Z2 at 145–170 W; 5 min cool-down. The 30 sec efforts should be crisp, not all-out. This preserves snap while keeping the day aerobic.

workouts.title: Rest · protect Friday
workouts.detail: No ride and no heavy legs. Easy walking, mobility, or 15–20 min upper-body/core only.

workouts.title: Zwift race simulation
workouts.detail: About 60 min total: 10 min progressive warm-up at 130–190 W with 3×10 sec openers; choose a useful 45–50 min race; 5 min easy cool-down. Race craft: stay economical, close dangerous gaps early, and make one committed 1–2 min move only when it can change position or selection. For the finish, launch earlier than instinct—the go-zone opens near 0.5 mi. If no suitable race or fatigue is abnormal, ride 60 min efficiently attached to an upper-B RoboPacer.

weeks.label: Durability + Attacks · Trial Week 1
weeks.emphasis: Build spring road-race durability and repeatable threshold surges; Friday is a useful hard training race, not an A-priority event. Protect illness recovery and adjust load to execution.

workouts.title: Long sweet spot · durability
workouts.detail: 65–80 min total: warm up 10–15 min; 2×20 min at 220–225 W, 5 min easy between; cool down. Keep controlled and smooth; no maximal finish.

workouts.title: Threshold with attacks
workouts.detail: 55–65 min total: warm up 12–15 min; 3×8 min blocks: repeat 2 min at 235–245 W followed by 20 sec at 325–335 W three times per block, then easy to finish each block as needed; 5 min easy between blocks; cool down. Keep recoveries controlled; reduce volume if Monday fatigue prevents good quality.

workouts.title: Aerobic endurance
workouts.detail: 60 min steady endurance, 145–170 W, conversational, no added attacks. Shorten or ease off if fatigue is excessive.

workouts.title: Recovery
workouts.detail: Rest by default, or 20–30 min very easy spin if beneficial. No heavy lower-body strength.

workouts.title: Zwift race · training stimulus
workouts.detail: Race hard when recovered, treating the race as training for Fat & Skinny Tire Fest rather than a weekly A-event. No routine taper required; choose a less intense alternative if illness or fatigue is abnormal.
